description: Williamson Tea Kenya Limited is a Kenya-based company engaged in the cultivation, manufacture and distribution of tea. The Company operates Changoi tea farm situated in the area of the Great Rift Valley; Kapchorua tea farm, located on the Nandi hills, Kaimosi farm placed in the North Nandi District, as well as Tinderet farm located in the vicinity of Great Rift Valley. Williamson Tea Kenya Limited distributes its products under Duchess Grey, Traditional Afternoon, Lifeboat Tea and Special Blend brands, among others.
